projection.purpose: Turn attributed authoring packages into deterministic definitions.

contract.input: A source snapshot, scene cards, text keys, locales and declared versions.
contract.step: Resolve every ID, guard, transition and localized text reference.
Preserve source digest, compiler identity and editorial status.
contract.reject: Block release when authorial choices remain unresolved or content is a fixture.

test.given: A scene references an absent localized key.
test.then: It reports the named missing key and emits no release package.
